React guarantees that the cleanup function returned by useEffect is executed whenever the dependency (isOpen) changes or when the component unmounts. When isOpen is true, originalOverflow and originalTouchAction are captured in closure and document.body styles are updated; upon unmount or when isOpen becomes false, the cleanup function reliably restores document.body.style.overflow and document.body.style.touchAction to their original values. Rapid toggling is also safe because React always invokes the prior cleanup before executing the subsequent effect setup.
